heroHeadline: Russia Fires Kinzhal + 147 Drones Overnight; Zelensky in Sweden Seals Gripen Deal; Father Killed at Kherson Playground — Day 1,554
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,554 of Russia's full-scale invasion, Russia launched overnight one Kh-47 Kinzhal aeroballistic missile and 147 attack UAVs (Shahed, Herber, Italmas types) at Ukraine — air defenses downed 138 of 147 drones (93.9%) but the Kinzhal was not intercepted; hits were confirmed at 7 locations. Russian MLRS fire struck a children's playground in Kherson's Korabelny district, killing a father and critically wounding his wife and two daughters (ages 3 and 6). President Zelensky visited Stockholm and announced a landmark Gripen deal: Sweden will donate 16 JAS 39 Gripen C/D jets and Ukraine agreed to purchase up to 20 Gripen E/F fighters for €2.5 billion from an EU support loan. Zelensky also submitted the €90 billion EU-Ukraine support loan ratification bill (No. 0376) to the Verkhovna Rada — €28.3B for defense and €16.7B for budget needs. Cumulative Russian losses reached ~1,360,110 (+1,160 on May 28 per Ukrainian General Staff).
